question: Which of the following banks was established as the Bank of Calcutta in the year 1806?
solution:
The correct answer is** __State Bank of India.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​​On June 2, 1806, **General Wellesley established the Bank of Calcutta**, a forerunner of the current State Bank of India, mostly to finance his campaigns against** Tipu Sultan **and the Marathas. It was the first bank in India, and on January 2, 1809, it adopted the name** Bank of Bengal.**
 
• SBI, the oldest **commercial bank in India,** began as the** Bank of Calcutta in 1806**. The Bank of Bengal was given a royal charter and a new name** three years later.**
 
• Following the** Imperial Bank of India's** conversion to state ownership, the **State Bank of India** was established in** July 1955. **
 
• **State Bank of India is a statutory organisation** for financial services and a** multinational public sector bank** with its headquarters in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**. SBI is the world's** 43rd largest bank and placed 221st** on the Fortune Global 500 list of the largest companies in the** world in 2020. **​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In accordance with a** GoI notification of June 22, 1964,** the Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI) was established as a **Development Financial Institution (DFI)** on July 1st, 1964, pursuant in reference to the **1964 Industrial Development Bank of India Act. **
 
• The **third-largest private sector bank in India** is Axis Bank. Large and mid-sized corporations, MSME, agriculture, and retail businesses are among the customer categories that the **Bank serves with its full range of financial services.**
 
• One of the **top public sector banks **in the nation is Union Bank of India. The** Government of India owns 83.50 percent** of the total share** capital of the Bank,** which is a public company. The Bank, which has its main office in Mumbai, India, was set up as a limited company on **November 11, 1919. **
